mapper.select: SELECT id, event_code, task_code, status, publishing_token, publishing_lease_until, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM document_upload_outbox_event WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_upload_outbox_event SET status = 2, publishing_token = #{publishingToken}, publishing_lease_until = #{publishingLeaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_code = #{eventCode} AND status = 0

UPDATE document_upload_outbox_event SET status = 1, publishing_token = NULL, publishing_lease_until = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_code = #{eventCode} AND status = 2 AND publishing_token = #{publishingToken}

UPDATE document_upload_outbox_event SET status = 0, publishing_token = NULL, publishing_lease_until = NULL, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_code = #{eventCode} AND status = 2 AND publishing_token = #{publishingToken}
